blocks.text: 🪝 Solar Defence Demonstrates Indigenous Counter-Swarm Drone System 'Bhargavastra'. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Vehicle-mounted multi-layered system neutralises autonomous drone swarms within 16 seconds.
System Architecture: Integrates unguided micro-rockets (20m lethal radius) and precision micro-missiles (interception range 2.5 km).
Target Detection: Detects large UAVs up to 10 km and small drones up to 6 km under MoD Make-II initiative.
